newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian TV shows Yeltsin looking alert.
newsitem.headline: Russian TV shows Yeltsin looking alert.

text.p: Russian television briefly showed President Boris Yeltsin looking alert during a meeting in the Kremlin on Tuesday.

Yeltsin, who left hospital on January 20 after pneumonia, also talked animatedly in the brief footage of talks with Ivan Korotchenya, secretary of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS). They were the first new pictures of the president to be shown since January 6.
Aides said Yeltsin, who turns 66 on Saturday, visited the Kremlin on Tuesday for the second time since he left hospital. He also had talks there with Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin.
Presidential press secretary Sergei Yastrzhembsky said Yeltsin had later returned to the Gorky-9 residence outside Moscow where he is convalescing.
Yeltsin's political opponents have questioned his ability to rule Russia and have discussed trying to remove him for health reasons.
The president also went to the Kremlin on January 22. But that visit was not shown on television and it failed to dampen speculation about Yeltsin's ability to rule.
